question: Does long-regime variation follow whole-model initialization or public training-stream namespace?
primary: H512 pre-sensing mature cancellation accuracy, averaged over the two fixed grids before paired-seed factorial effects
decision: Report initialization and training-stream main effects independently. A meaningful effect requires absolute mean>=.05 and paired five-seed exploratory95% t(df4) interval excluding zero. Conditional effects and interaction are secondary; no failed primary can be rescued.
reliability: Every seed on each grid: accuracy>=.8, swap drop>=.1, selected failures<=.05, unnecessary<=.10, cost<=.80; mean selected<=mean model-only. Never average away a failed grid.
runtime_control: All four corners retrained sequentially within one process/runtime block per seed, in prospective seeded order. No historical trained checkpoint supplies a corner.
limits: Whole-model initialization changes encoder, writer and reader together
Training namespace changes public histories and deterministic receipt choices together
Only long recipe tested; no attribution to episode/receipt exposure or optimizer alone
CPU differences across seeds remain; all four corners within a seed share runtime
Fixed8 synthetic structured graph; no native TAC/CASM success
